# mcloud env

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

An app's plain environment variables, for all its functions.

Plain (not secret) environment variables for every function of the app,
like a Worker's vars. They come from two places:

  - env: in maxcloud.yaml, kept in git and deployed with the app: the
    manifests carry them, so a change is a deploy. These win.
  - mcloud env set: kept in the ConfigMap app-env in the app's
    namespace, for values that change without a deploy. The maxcloud
    controller keeps a copy and puts it back after a cluster rebuild.

Setting or removing one restarts the app's HTTP and queue functions, so
they have it right away (--no-restart: on their next start). Scheduled
functions get it on their next run. For anything secret, use mcloud
secrets: values here are readable by anyone who can see the app.

Run these in the app's repo, or name the app with --app.

| Command | |
| --- | --- |
| [`mcloud env get`](#mcloud-env-get) | Print a variable's value |
| [`mcloud env list`](#mcloud-env-list) | List the app's variables and their values |
| [`mcloud env set`](#mcloud-env-set) | Set (or change) variables |
| [`mcloud env unset`](#mcloud-env-unset) | Remove variables set with mcloud env set |

## mcloud env get

Print a variable's value.

Print a variable's value, as the app's functions get it: maxcloud.yaml's
env (in this checkout) wins over what mcloud env set keeps in the cluster.

```
mcloud env get NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |

## mcloud env list

List the app's variables and their values.

List the app's variables as NAME=VALUE lines (a .env file): those from
maxcloud.yaml's env (in this checkout), then those set with mcloud env set,
each group under a comment. A variable in both is listed once, with
maxcloud.yaml's value: that's the one the functions get.

```
mcloud env list [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |

## mcloud env set

Set (or change) variables.

```
mcloud env set NAME=VALUE... [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud env set LOG_LEVEL=debug
mcloud env set API_BASE=https://api.example.com FEATURE_X=on
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `--no-restart` |  | don't restart the functions; they get the change when they next start |

## mcloud env unset

Remove variables set with mcloud env set.

```
mcloud env unset NAME... [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `--no-restart` |  | don't restart the functions; they get the change when they next start |
